frames:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game UI skin atlas for an existing high-detail pixel-art top-down underwater ruin roguelike. This is a reusable sprite sheet, not a screen mockup.
Create exactly SIX square UI plates in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, on a truly transparent 1536x1024 canvas. Each 512x512 cell contains one identical-size 448x448 square plate centered with 32px transparent padding. Keep every plate completely separated. Front-facing orthographic 2D, no perspective. Each plate has straight edges and tiny stepped corner cuts, a narrow 24px rim, small 8px squared corner inlays, and a large completely plain solid dark center for readable UI text. No text, no glyphs, no labels, no numbers, no shadows outside the plate.
Read order:
1 top-left: recessed dark slate panel, pale blue-grey stone rim, subtle worn brass corner inlays, center deep navy #14232f.
2 top-middle: normal raised button, blue-grey/teal rim, dark desaturated teal center #263e49, light top bevel and dark bottom bevel.
3 top-right: focus/selected button, warm muted gold rim with very small pale turquoise corner accents, center #304d55.
4 bottom-left: pressed button, clearly recessed bevel (upper edge darker, lower edge lighter), dark teal center #182e38.
5 bottom-middle: disabled button, flat grey slate rim, desaturated center #283039, readable medium contrast, no glow.
6 bottom-right: slim HUD well, restrained steel-grey rim, center very dark navy #111f2a.
Style: crisp deliberate true pixel clusters and hard stepped edges, no anti-aliasing, no photographic texture, no smooth gradients, no bloom. Finely crafted but quiet. Material colour edges, no thick black cartoon outlines. Match a world of blue-grey square stone floor tiles, carved stone columns, warm brass coins, cyan crystals, and simple pixel creatures. Avoid shells, skulls, coral flourishes, cracks, logos, letters, futuristic circuitry. All detail on the narrow borders, the middle 85% is empty uniform colour. These will be nine-sliced, so straight edge strips must be repetitive and corners compact.
icons:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art UI icon atlas for an underwater-ruin top-down game.
A precisely regular 6-column by 6-row sprite sheet, 1536x1536 transparent canvas, exactly 36 isolated icons in 256px square cells, one at the center of each cell. Every icon fits an inner 160x160 square leaving ample transparent margins. Front-facing flat pixel art, legible silhouette at 24px display size, same pixel density throughout, crisp hard pixel clusters, no smoothing or glow, no card backgrounds or labels. Palette muted ivory, blue-grey slate, sea-green teal, warm gold, cyan crystal, muted red health; thin material-colour edges, simple two-tone bevels consistent with stone ruins and gold coins. Not emoji, no font glyph rendering.
Read order left to right, top to bottom:
row1: gold coin stack; red heart; blue shield; cyan energy crystal; unfolded parchment map; closed blue field-guide book with tiny gold clasp.
row2: pause symbol as two ivory stone bars; play arrow as ivory stone triangle; small gear; speaker with sound waves; crossed muted speaker; globe showing meridians.
row3: four-way move arrows; crosshair; fast dash boot with two motion marks; two curved swap arrows; open hand interaction; small arched doorway.
row4: return arrow; circular restart arrow; check mark; close X; open padlock; closed padlock.
row5: radiant gold talent star; treasure chest; green exit stairs; gold crown for boss; small diamond for unexplored room; compass.
row6: large beveled numeral 3; large beveled numeral 2; large beveled numeral 1; small droplet; sun/lightning flash; an artist's layout grid of four little rectangles.
Constraints: Exactly one recognizable symbol per cell, no extra fragments between cells. Consistent screen-front orientation and scale. Numerals are hand-pixelled ivory with teal side shade, no other letters or numbers. No shells, no skulls, no cartoon faces, no high-detail realistic textures. These are real UI sprites, not a showcase with typography.
controls:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: six touch-control sprites for a fine pixel-art underwater stone ruin game.
Transparent 1536x1024 sprite sheet, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, identical 512px square cells. Each circular control is centered in its cell, maximum outside diameter 440px, fully isolated with transparent padding. Orthographic front view only. Crisp hard pixel clusters and stepped circular silhouettes, carefully limited blue-grey slate, desaturated teal, ivory and warm brass. No smooth gradients, no blur, no bloom, no text, no glyphs, no numbers. Thin material-colour outlines, no heavy black border.
Top-left: movement joystick base, thin concentric slate and teal bezel, eight restrained cardinal ticks, mostly empty transparent middle.
Top-middle: movement thumb knob, simple solid slate disk with a small raised teal inset, clean light upper bevel, dark lower bevel, no symbol.
Top-right: attack joystick base, thin concentric muted brass and slate bezel, four restrained cardinal ticks, mostly empty transparent middle.
Bottom-left: attack thumb knob, simple solid warm gold and slate disk, clean light upper bevel and dark lower bevel, no symbol.
Bottom-middle: small pause button base, dark teal circular face, thin blue-grey rim, plain empty center to receive a separate icon.
Bottom-right: return-to-battle countdown medallion, broad dark navy center for a large number, delicate warm gold segmented rim and four small cyan corner-like marks at cardinal directions. No number in the center.
Uniform moderate pixel detail and UI-friendly silhouette, matching carved stone floor and wall modules, gold coins and cyan crystals. Keep every element entirely inside its cell and keep the background truly transparent.
controlsAlpha: Edit this production game sprite sheet by removing the entire background to true alpha transparency. Keep all six existing control designs exactly, same pixel art, colours, positions and sizes. Remove every blurred coloured halo, the dark grey/black/gold backdrop outside every sprite, and remove the interior background inside the two hollow joystick rings in the TOP LEFT and TOP RIGHT. Those two centers must be truly transparent. The other four discs remain opaque inside. Do not redraw or add any background. Deliver RGBA with transparent pixels, a genuine cutout sheet.
